summary: Test suite provides solid unit test coverage of module functions (Get-CurrentVersion, Get-VersionBumpType, Get-NextVersion, Set-Version, New-ChangelogEntry) and validates workflow structure, but critically fails the explicit task requirement that 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT'. The task mandates a test harness that: (1) sets up temp git repos per test case, (2) runs `act push --rm`, (3) captures output to `act-result.txt`, (4) asserts exact values from workflow output (not just that tests pass). This harness is entirely absent. Additionally, no tests directly invoke the CLI entry point (Invoke-VersionBump.ps1) or verify GitHub Actions output variables. Fixture files (commits-feat.txt, commits-fix.txt, commits-breaking.txt) are referenced but never verified to exist or contain expected data. Tests cover happy path and basic errors well but lack multi-commit scenarios, special characters, malformed JSON edge cases, and large version numbers. Would not catch regressions in actual GitHub Actions pipeline execution.
